  • Two tracks in one plane: the real limit, and how close we get 2026-10-07ReconstructionTwo-track

    Physical limit ~1 strip pitch, real-track limit 2–3 mm; an opt-in fixed chain triples A’s close-pair efficiency and passes the real-trigger contract. F rescan pending.

  • Reducing MX17 Material Budget → 16° to 4° scattering 2026-10-06NTOFGeant4Multiple scatteringOpening angleTarget

    Ray-traced material budgets and X17 opening-angle peak: 1.8% → 0.13% X₀, σ68 16° → 3.8°; appendix with a ⁴He bag.

  • Scintillator stack, mapped by the tracks 2026-10-06X17ScintillatorsCalibration

    Efficiency and response heat maps of every SiPM wall, plastic and liquid on the four arms, from MM tracks on the imaging calibration.

  • Beam-off cosmics on the n_TOF clock 2026-10-02BackgroundsCosmicsTiming

    57.6 h of production-point cosmics, never analysed; matched to n_TOF without beam: 92 % of in-window triggers within ±50 ns, 11 ns core. First sub-run; growing.

  • ILL X17 feasibility: the Geant4 campaign in slides 2026-10-02ILLSimulation

    Reach, event statistics, why 200 ps timing, cosmic vetoes (ceiling panel, segment collinearity), where the accidentals come from (aluminium), vertex and cell radius.

  • ILL ³He target: helium bag and ³He leak rate 2026-10-02IllTargetHe3

    Air ¹⁴N comes from the 30 cm beam path, so a He flight tube fixes it; a balloon around the target does not help and floods the mylar cell. Bare 12 µm mylar loses ~22 L of ³He per cycle; a 1 bar cell with a 12 µm PET + 6–7 µm Al-foil skin cuts that >1000× for +3 % scattering. The foil sits outside the beam, Al is the right metal, and the scattering is set by the Micromegas entrance and the air.
